name: generate_captions
description: Caption a project's audio, writing project["captions"]. The words are each unmuted clip's and voiceover's own transcript, mapped through the timeline (music and sfx left out); an untranscribed one: its mix is transcribed. Groups words into styled segments (cap-<n> ids), carries the prior track's theme (all but style and segments) and keeps its translated rows (lang + translationOf). Mute is read at generation only. Run async (montaj_step async:true), poll montaj_step_status. Takes a project id.

input.description: No file input — operates on a project by id (see project-id param).

output.description: The caption track JSON ({"style", "segments":[...]}) that was written to project["captions"].

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model. The default is multilingual.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. en, es, fr), or 'auto' for language auto-detection.

params.name: audio
params.description: Audio tracks read besides clips' own audio: voice (type voiceover; none audible: all, answer flags noVoiceTrack), all, or track ids.

params.name: style
params.description: Caption animation style. Defaults to the prior caption track's style, then the profile's caption style (a new track also takes the profile's caption font), then 'pop'.

params.name: replace-edited
params.description: Lines a person made or edited are kept (the answer names them as keptYours). True replaces them too: only when the person asks.

params.name: script
params.description: The script the speaker read. Defaults to the project's editing prompt (its <tags> left out), so a script given there needs no param; an empty string turns it off. Caption words take its spelling on the transcript's timings (a misheard word that reads alike is replaced; words not in it stay as heard). The answer counts `corrected`.
